question: The Dree Festival, an important agricultural festival, is primarily celebrated by the Apatani tribe in the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dree Festival:**

 
 
• **The Dree Festival is an occasion to honour agriculture, which provides the majority of Arunachal Pradesh's Ziro population with a living.**
 
• Every year, on July 5th, the Dree festival is observed; festivities go off on July 4th.
